bridge.narrative: OpenAI announces ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry GA Tuesday for Singapore-cloud and Japan-cloud tenants across Azure OpenAI plus AWS Bedrock plus Google Cloud Vertex simultaneously, citing the Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI MoC and the Sunday-shipped South Korea PIPC plus New Zealand GCSB cyber-eval reciprocity attestation fields as operative tenant-policy schema; 87 enterprise customers by Tuesday close; Indo-Pacific perimeter widens to eleven jurisdictions plus Chile and Mexico exploratory.
